patterns.message: Mobile consumes only the pure packages: @bespoke/schema and @bespoke/domain for values, plus `import type { AppRouter }` from @bespoke/api (stage 1). @bespoke/ui is web/DOM and @bespoke/db is server-only — neither runs on React Native.
The only allowed @bespoke/api import is `import type { AppRouter }` from the package root (type-only, erased at build). Subpaths are server-only value surfaces that would fail at Metro bundle time.
Only `import type { AppRouter }` may come from @bespoke/api — every other export is server-only.
Reach across directories through an alias: `@/*` for src, `@assets/*` for assets. Relative paths are for siblings that move together.
